comment: Do NOT take. I don't know who was teaching when people say they had a positive experience-couldn't have been him. In this class we literally sat and listened to him reiterate the book of the week for 3 hours. Grade was based on one final paper & participation, I went to class every week and participated, still got a B (my lowest grade in at UR).

Very good teacher... but VERY HARD. Very hard grader.. grades like you are in law school. Lectures definitely get boring but class is not mandatory. However, I came out of the class feeling like I learned a ton and improved my writing a ton.
HE IS THE WORST PROFESSOR I HAVE EVER HAD. Doesnt teach the topic of the class at all. Boring lectures. Rips apart papers that are not even that bad. Worst. Do not take his class.

Great teacher. Very helpful. Just wants students to do well. Treats students with respect and expects same in return. Very very smart man. A little scary at first but if you come prepared for class you will do well.

McGarvie is an interesting guy. He's a hard essay grader and is very particular about the words you choose in class as well as on papers. Participation is 50% of the class which makes it kind of annoying though. He's kind of biased, but will give merit to  you if you disagree with him but have a clear point.

Had him first semester freshman class. Does not like athletes and is very biased. He told me I did everything wrong.  When I went to him for help, told me to drop the class, I couldn't do anything right and should examine my reasons for choosing a school.  So much for a "teacher".  He doesn't want to teach-he wants students who already know.  Do No

I don't see how people can say he knows his stuff. In our American Revolution class he asked "Who was that guy with the green mountain men?" I love revolutionary war topics until he ruined it for me. He said "I don't care about names or dates, they aren't important. It's the ideas." Ok.

The WOSRT teacher I have ever had. His grading is absolutely ridiculous for 100 level requirement course. After spending hours on papers he still tears them apart and gives you Ds.  Whatever you do DO NOT TAKE THIS PROFESSOR! You could come away with a better history grade if you take another course and just don't show up. McGargive is the worst.

Good professor. So his style might still be 70s -- students should be there to learn, not to make style commentary. He knows his stuff and is more than eager to put in a lot of time to look over papers, explain concepts or to help in whatever other way he can, whether related to his class. Smart, good guy, good professor.
All I remember from this class was that it was so boring, I just wanted to shoot myself the whole time.  I don't think I did any work though.
If you are a history major this is the guy to take if you want to learn how to write history papers.  Great professor who wants to help and can really help you in future classes.

DO NOT TAKE THIS CLASS. You will think your papers are good, or at least decent, and he will rip them apart. Doesn't teach the material at all, and the papers are not even on the material. First paper was about how to use documents to write a paper. Completely unrealistic teacher, and grades like it's grad. school.

With his strawberry blonde hair kissed by the sun, his bright colorful argile, and robbins egg blue pants this man although smart in an "un-encyclopedia britannica" sort of way does not articulate anything except the lack of intellect in our generation.  His expectations for a 100 level class are unreal.

Had him for Native American, he is a good lecturer but you are expected to participate a lot (it is most of your grade, there was only one assignment the whole semester). GO SEE him with a rough draft of every paper you have to write, he gives constructive criticism. Not an easy teacher, but worth it if you are serious about history.
No Comments
dresses like a****and has unreal expectations for his 100 level class.  Apperears helpful but when you go and meet with him he rips you apart don't take him!

McGarvie may be the smartest man alive.  His classes tend to be boring but you do learn alot.  Attendance policy is very lax.  If you get on his good side you can get an easy A.  Talk with him after class and make sure he knows your name.  Highly recommend.

really knows the subject well. there are no tests or quizes, and relativley few papers. if you go to class, participate, and show him interest, and go in for help on papers you will get a good grade. i would take him again
do NOT take him for a 100 level history requirement. grades extremely hard on papers. smart guy, but not good for a 100 level class.

This guy knows exactly what he's talking about. Too bad he can't relate it to the class he's teaching. He's written two books and he loves talking about himself like he's God. Oh well. At least he dresses funny so you can have something to look forward to every class.
no tests or quizzes, only papers. which may sound good, but he grades your papers SO hard. unreal expectations for a 100 level class.

he sucked!! he had unreal expectations considering it was a 100 level class and we were not his LAW STUDENTS...dont ever take him!! i hate him so much!! I dont know how the rest of you liked him but OMG i strongly dislike him!! and would never take another class with him ever again!
at first i fell asleep each lecture...but his style of teaching grew on me quickly...i really enjoyed the final application of all of the lectures on the final...

Ever seen Ben Stein on Ferris Bueller?  yeah...  He's a really nice guy and willing to help when you need it, but he is soooo boring.  Not much work day-to-day but grades paper like the lawyer he is.  He does lack fashion sense in any sense of the phrase.  But he's a decent teacher--I'd recommend.
Nice guy, but soooo boring. Voice is so monotone and he pretty much looks like a little golden guy.  Eager to help, but unclear of what he wants.
weirdo.  too smart for earth.

Knows history in and out, honestly wants to help students, although unrealistic about students' willingness to start 3 page term paper at beginning of semester, can be very boring and his voice put me to sleep, no idea of grade until final grades are out
Great Historian. Easy to figure out what he wants. Lacking fashion any fasion sense.
